numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across both series as on Wikipedia: Clannad is 1-23 and After Story is 24-47 (the two alternate-world OVAs are not numbered).

arcs.name: Meeting Nagisa
arcs.summary: Delinquent student Tomoya Okazaki meets Nagisa Furukawa, a shy girl hoping to revive her school's drama club. Between their conversations, he keeps glimpsing a strange, empty world.
events: Tomoya meets Nagisa at the foot of the hill and starts helping her revive the drama club.
Tomoya first visits the Furukawa bakery and meets Nagisa's parents, Akio and Sanae.
Nagisa's poor health and Tomoya's injured shoulder are revealed.

arcs.name: Fuko Arc
arcs.summary: A small girl wanders the school handing out hand-carved starfish as gifts for her sister's wedding.
events: Fuko turns out to be in a coma, and the girl at school is something like her spirit.
The group helps convince Kouko to hold her wedding with Yusuke.
Fuko gradually fades from people's memories, but her friends remember her in time for the wedding.

arcs.name: Kotomi Arc
arcs.summary: Tomoya befriends Kotomi Ichinose, a genius who spends her days reading alone in the library.
events: Kotomi's disastrous violin playing and her shyness are brought out as she joins the drama club.
Kotomi's parents turn out to have died in a plane crash years ago, and Tomoya recalls knowing her as a child.
Her friends restore her overgrown garden, and a briefcase from her late parents helps her move on.

arcs.name: School Life: Sunohara, Kyou and Tomoyo
arcs.summary: The drama club runs into roadblocks while the story spends time with Tomoya's other friends.
events: Nagisa can't find a faculty advisor and briefly gives up on the drama club.
Tomoya, Youhei and Kyou win a three-on-three basketball game against the basketball club.
Tomoya is suspended after a fight, and Tomoyo becomes student council president.

arcs.name: Nagisa Arc: The School Play
arcs.summary: The drama club is finally revived, and Nagisa prepares to perform her play at the school festival.
events: Tomoya moves in with the Furukawas to escape his father.
Nagisa learns her parents gave up their dreams to care for her when she nearly died as a child.
Nagisa freezes on stage, but her parents' encouragement lets her finish the play, and Tomoya confesses to her.

arcs.name: Summer Break (extra)
arcs.summary: A summer side story in which Youhei's sister Mei tries to move Tomoya and Nagisa's relationship forward.
events: Mei invents embarrassing plans to push the shy couple together.
Tomoya and Nagisa finally hold hands.

arcs.name: Sunohara and Mei
arcs.summary: As summer ends, Mei returns worried about her brother Youhei's aimless life.
events: Akio's baseball team wins a local game on Tomoya's final hit.
Sanae poses as Youhei's girlfriend to reassure Mei.
Youhei's lost soccer career is revealed, and he fights the soccer club to protect Mei.

arcs.name: Misae Arc
arcs.summary: Tomoya learns about the past of Misae Sagara, the dorm mother of Youhei's boarding house.
events: A boy Misae once knew, Katsuki Shima, is revealed to have been granting her wishes.
Misae's wish is fulfilled and an orb of light appears.

arcs.name: Yukine Arc
arcs.summary: Quiet library girl Yukine gets Tomoya involved in a feud between local gangs.
events: Yukine's brother Kazuto is revealed to have died, ending the gang fighting.
Yukine shares the legend of the orbs of light that grant wishes.

arcs.name: Graduation and Working Life
arcs.summary: Tomoya graduates and starts working, while Nagisa must repeat her final year.
events: Nagisa's illness forces her to repeat her last year of school.
Tomoya becomes an electrician under Yusuke.
Tomoya proposes, earns Akio's blessing, and marries Nagisa.

arcs.name: Nagisa's Pregnancy
arcs.summary: The newlyweds begin their life together, but Nagisa's fragile health shadows good news.
events: Nagisa becomes pregnant and decides to keep the baby despite the risk.
Nagisa dies shortly after giving birth to their daughter, Ushio.

arcs.name: Ushio Arc
arcs.summary: Five years later, Tomoya has left Ushio in the Furukawas' care, until he's pushed to become a father.
events: Tomoya bonds with Ushio on a trip and learns from his grandmother how his own father sacrificed for him.
Tomoya reconciles with his father, who moves back to the countryside.
Ushio falls ill with the same sickness as Nagisa and dies in Tomoya's arms.

arcs.name: The Illusionary World
arcs.summary: The story of the girl in the illusionary world reaches its end.
events: The girl in the illusionary world is revealed to be connected to Ushio.
The orbs Tomoya collected let him rewrite events so that Nagisa survives childbirth.

arcs.name: One Year Before (extra)
arcs.summary: A side story set a year before the series begins.
events: Nagisa is knocked out by a prank Tomoya and Youhei set up, and a classmate befriends her.
Nagisa keeps an encouraging message Tomoya wrote, which helped her make the friend.

arcs.name: Under the Green Tree (recap)
arcs.summary: A recap episode in which Tomoya retells the story to Ushio.
events: Tomoya tells Ushio the story of how he met Nagisa.
The family has a picnic under the tree.

filler.note: Anime Filler List counts episodes 13-14 and 16-18 as filler because they are not in the manga, though they draw on side content from the visual novel; episode 47 is a recap.
